payload.name: Fitiger ASD and SPED Mealtime Choking Readiness Resource
payload.description: Free educational resource for caregivers, schools, and disability-support teams on mealtime choking-risk planning for autistic students and special education settings. It focuses on observation, readiness steps, supervision planning, communication, and when to call emergency services. It does not replace CPR, first aid training, emergency medical services, or professional medical advice.
payload.phone: Fitiger Life LLC, 1037 S Claremont St, San Mateo, CA 94402, USA; info@fitiger.net; +1 (458)-250-0756

payload.name: Special Needs USA
payload.description: Special Needs USA is a free resource that helps families find special needs schools, therapy providers, and support options with current availability. Families can search by location and need, then connect with relevant providers. We work to keep information current so families can find support faster.

payload.name: Community Support of the Piedmont
payload.description:
Our medical equipment loan closet provides essential medical equipment
free of charge to community members in need. We maintain a large inventory of clean, well-maintained equipment ready for immediate use.

payload.name: Therapeutic Recreation Services
payload.description: NCS Therapeutic Recreation Services (TRS) is committed to providing services, education and resources to meet the needs of participants and assist them on the road toward lifelong participation and enjoyment in recreation and leisure activities. Staff provide support and advocacy to individuals who wish to participate in general recreation activities.
payload.address: 12011 Government Center Parkway, 10th Floor Fairfax, VA 22035

payload.name: Summer Camps - Therapeutic Recreation Camps
payload.description:
Therapeutic Recreation Services' (TRS) elementary and teen camps are traditional day camp programs modified and structured to meet the unique needs of the disability community.  They are designed to engage campers in a variety of leisure activities, develop new leisure interests, socialize with peers, have fun and build independence skills.  

TRS preschool camp is a structured play program for preschool children with and without developmental delays and/or disabilities
payload.address: 12011 Government Center Parkway, 10th Floor Fairfax, VA 22035

payload.name: Family Autism Night - F.A.N.tastic Times
payload.description: Family Autism Night is a program offered by Therapeutic Recreation Services – a branch of the Department of Neighborhood and Community Services. It is a FREE drop-in program for individuals with disabilities ages 2 to 22 years old and their families. Planned activities provide an opportunity for the community to come together and have fun playing, socializing, and interacting with other families. Activities are held once a month during September through May.
payload.address: 12011 Government Center Parkway, 10th Floor Fairfax, VA 22035

payload.name: Adaptive Sports - Fairfax Falcons Paralympic Sports Team
payload.description: The Fairfax Falcons Paralympic Sports Team provides adaptive basketball opportunities for youth with physical disabilities across Northern Virginia and the Washington, DC area. We offer a supportive, inclusive environment where athletes can build skills, stay active, and grow in confidence.
